breaks: The next number ignores the result files, so after fx stops between a file and its index line the next number is taken. The save refuses it and the retry gets the same number, so the result is not saved (result_files.zig nextNumber, publish).

The next number is the highest one in use, so a save asks for a number that is taken. The save refuses it, and the retry asks for the same number, so the result is not saved (result_files.zig nextNumber, publish).
A save that keeps the whole output reports a file that was never written, so its index line names a file that is not there (result_files.zig save, the branch without a cut).
A result whose output finds no room is not saved, and its text drops the notice that says so (bash_results.zig writeHeader).
